source.organization: Not recorded; CSV notes reference Olympedia

reference.policy: All supplied editions except 1906; separate 1956 Stockholm equestrian table included once as documented by CSV

methodology.ranking: Descending total medals; competition ranks (1, 2, 2, 4) within the 197-country pool
methodology.matching: Explicit NOC aliases, otherwise canonical IDs; historical and special teams excluded without redistribution
methodology.germany: GER through 1936, 1952 and from 1992; GER 1956–1964, FRG and GDR excluded for both seasons
methodology.russia: RUS before 1917 excluded; URS, EUN and ROC/OAR excluded
methodology.missing: Absent eligible source rows receive user-approved zero counts, competition ranks and capped points
methodology.year: Coverage endpoint, not the year of the last medal
caveats: CSV-only processing authorized by user: art medals are retained in source totals. Sports-only compliance is NOT established.
Sport/event/official-status fields are absent: demonstration, unofficial and unawarded medal exclusion cannot be independently checked.
One row is a team/edition medal table, not an athlete record. Rows are summed once; event-level team deduplication cannot be independently verified.
User-approved gameplay rule: countries without eligible CSV medal rows receive zero medals, including nonparticipants; this is not independent verification of participation history.
UAR is excluded rather than transferred to Egypt; Egypt may have an incomplete continuity total under another convention.
TPE maps to Taiwan using the CSV team identity; no attribution of other Chinese teams. Historical code changes absent from the CSV cannot be reconstructed.
Source notes mention Olympedia, but exact publisher, download URL, dataset version and retrieval date are not recorded. No external data used.

validation.verifiedAgainst: Supplied CSV only; no independent sports-only verification
